title: Algebraic techniques and index laws
summary: The language of algebra, substitution, like terms, algebraic fractions, expanding, factorising and the first index laws.

cards.title: The language of algebra
cards.rule: In \(3x + 5\): \(x\) is a pronumeral, 3 is the coefficient, 5 is the constant.

cards.title: Substitution and equivalence
cards.rule: Replace each letter with its value. Equivalent expressions are equal for every value.

cards.title: Adding and subtracting terms
cards.rule: Only like terms (same letters, same powers) can be added or subtracted.

cards.title: Multiplying and dividing terms
cards.rule: Multiply the numbers, then the letters. Divide like a fraction and cancel.

cards.title: Algebraic fractions: + and −
cards.rule: Use a common denominator, then combine the numerators.

cards.title: Algebraic fractions: × and ÷
cards.rule: Cancel common factors, then multiply. To divide, flip the second fraction.

cards.title: Expanding brackets
cards.rule: Multiply every term inside by the term outside.

cards.title: Factorising
cards.rule: The opposite of expanding: take out the highest common factor.

cards.title: Applying algebra
cards.rule: Use a letter for the unknown and write a rule.
lines: Phone plan: $20 plus $0.50 a text: \(C = 20 + 0.5t\). 40 texts: \(\$40\)

cards.title: Index laws: × and ÷
cards.rule: Same base: multiply, add the indices. Divide, subtract them.

cards.title: Zero index and power of a power
cards.rule: Anything to the power 0 is 1. Power of a power: multiply the indices.
